function calculate()
              local sid0_list = {}
              for i = 1, #user_profile_v1_click_semantic_id_list, 3 do
                local value = user_profile_v1_click_semantic_id_list[i]
                if value and value ~= 0 then
                  table.insert(sid0_list, math.floor(value * 1000))
                end
              end
              local count_map = {}
              for _, v in ipairs(sid0_list) do
                  count_map[v] = (count_map[v] or 0) + 1
              end
              -- 将结果转换为数组并排序
              local count_list = {}
              for k, v in pairs(count_map) do
                  table.insert(count_list, {value = k, count = v})
              end
              -- 排序函数
              table.sort(count_list, function(a, b)
                  return a.count > b.count
              end)
              -- 取出出现次数最多的前10个数
              local top_10 = {}
              local top_10_count = 0
              for i = 1, math.min(10, #count_list) do
                  table.insert(top_10, count_list[i].value)
                  top_10_count = top_10_count + count_list[i].count
              end
              return top_10, #sid0_list, top_10_count, #sid0_list / #count_list, top_10_count / math.min(10, #count_list)
            end
